file_id: Vulla Durga Rao vs The State Of Ap on 13 November, 2019

sentences.text:
Vulla Durga Rao vs The State Of Ap on 13 November, 2019
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.V.S.S.Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.6507 of 2019
Order:

entities.text: Vulla Durga Rao vs The State Of Ap
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1. This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner / Accused No.1 under section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against the petitioner, in FIR No.503 of 2018, on the file of the Station House Officer, Gajuwaka Police Station, Visakhapatnam.
The alleged offences against the petitioner are under sections 188, 273 r/w 34 of IPC and Sections 59(I), 59(II) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Heard Sri R.Siva Sai Swarup, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent / State.
3.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the Judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
4. In view of the fact, that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in FIR No.503 of 2018, on the file of the Station House Officer, Gajuwaka Police Station, Visakhapatnam for the offences under sections 188,
273 r/w 34 of IPC and Sections 59(I), 59(II) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal petition shall stand closed.

______________________________ SRI D.V.S.S.SOMAYAJULU,J Date: 13.11.2019 rpd.
